descriptor.determiners: priors.js DEFINITE_DETERMINERS + INDEFINITE_DETERMINERS (giver lang/en, the-fold P41)
descriptor.posPriorGate: hypergraph.js::makeRelationReader posPriorFor -> relations.js::discoverRelationVocab's own posPrior param (giver UD_English-EWT, CC BY-SA 4.0) — TYPE-level vocabulary gate: verbShare > 0.5 across attested uses admits, an unattested form is NOT refused, ACTIVE at vocabulary discovery (before extractRelations runs)
descriptor.classifyConnector: wordclass.js dominantClass (giver UD_English-EWT, CC BY-SA 4.0) — minShare 0.5, per-EDGE DISCLOSURE ONLY, never gates admission (see posPriorGate above for the vocabulary-level gate, which is a different mechanism and IS active)
descriptor.resolvePronouns: eoreader7/native adapters/text/pronouns.js resolvePronouns — kernel/activation.js one-hop recall through kernel/contest.js co-presence veto (minActivation/minMargin at PRONOUN_MIN_ACTIVATION/PRONOUN_MIN_MARGIN, hypergraph.js's own declared floor, unvalidated against a golden — see hypergraph.js header)

unionOmitted.verbForms: available and measured (319->737 edges on a 10-file sample) but withheld — widens recall rather than closing a false binding, a separate decision from wiring activation
unionOmitted.createLemmatizer: available but not yet paired with a lemma index verified against this corpus's own vocabulary
unionOmitted.morphologyIndex: no organ produces this shape on any engine path today
unionOmitted.classifyConnector: loaded above for a DIFFERENT call site (disclosure-only, P56); not re-wired here as makeRelationReader's own accepted organ under this name without checking that distinction first
unionOmitted.minShare: moot while classifyConnector is unset above
unionOmitted.extractLeadingSurfaces: no organ under this name exists on the native adapters/text/surfaces.js path as of this pass
unionOmitted.casePrior: Latin case-marking prior — this reader is makeRelationReader, the English positional reader, not makeCaseMarkedRelationReader

entries.task_id: action|is|transitory--a step
entries.description: Action is transitory--a step
entries.subject: Action

spans.text: _"Action is transitory--a step, a blow, The motion of a muscle--this way or that-- 'Tis done, and in the after-vacancy We wonder at ourselves like men betrayed: Suffering is permanent, obscure, and dark, And shares the nature of infinity_."

entries.task_id: the face of the down itself|was|still in darkness
entries.description: the face of the down itself was still in darkness
entries.subject: the face of the down itself

spans.text: In the southeast a pale dawn light was beginning to show above the curving hollow of the down wherein the village lay enfolded; but the face of the down itself was still in darkness.

entries.task_id: venus|shone|enthroned
entries.description: Venus shone enthroned
entries.subject: Venus

spans.text: Farther to the south, in a stretch of clear night sky hardly touched by the mounting dawn, Venus shone enthroned, so large and brilliant, so near to earth and the spectator, that she held, she pervaded the whole dusky scene, the shadowed fields and wintry woods, as though she were their very soul and voice.

spans.text: After the striking of the quarter, the church bell began to ring, with a gentle, yet insistent note which gradually filled the hollows of the village, and echoed along the side of the down.

entries.subject: Once or twice the sound

spans.text: Once or twice the sound was effaced by the rush and roar of a distant train; and once the call of an owl from a wood, a call melancholy and prolonged, was raised as though in rivalry.

entries.task_id: that|was|for early service
entries.description: That was for early service
entries.subject: That

spans.text: That was for early service," she thought; and there flashed into her mind an image of the old parish church, dimly lit for the Christmas Eucharist, its walls and pillars decorated with ivy and holly, yet austere and cold through all its adornings, with its bare walls and pale windows.

entries.task_id: christmas|waited|while the dawn stole upon the night
entries.description: Christmas waited while the dawn stole upon the night
entries.subject: Christmas
entries.object: while the dawn stole upon the night

spans.text: And there, with her face pressed against the glass, she waited while the dawn stole upon the night, while in the park the trees emerged upon the grass white with rime, while on the face of the down thickets and paths became slowly visible, while the first wreaths of smoke began to curl and hover in the frosty air.

entries.task_id: diana mallory|saw|a flock of sheep
entries.description: Diana Mallory saw a flock of sheep
entries.subject: Diana Mallory

spans.text: Suddenly, on a path which climbed the hill-side till it was lost in the beech wood which crowned the summit, she saw a flock of sheep, and behind them a shepherd boy running from side to side.

entries.task_id: when harold|was|on christmas way to senlac--that hill
entries.description: when Harold was on Christmas way to Senlac--that hill
entries.subject: when Harold
entries.object: on Christmas way to Senlac--that hill

spans.text: On the morning of Charles I.'s execution--in the winters and springs when Elizabeth was Queen--while Becket lay dead on Canterbury steps--when Harold was on his way to Senlac--that hill, that path were there--sheep were climbing it, and shepherds were herding them.

entries.task_id: the village|was|hidden from it by boundary woods
entries.description: the village was hidden from it by boundary woods
entries.subject: the village
entries.object: hidden from it by boundary woods

spans.text: Pastures studded with trees sloped away from the house on all sides; the village was hidden from it by boundary woods; only the church tower emerged.

entries.task_id: the deep oriel window where she sat diana|could see|a projecting wing of the house itself
entries.description: the deep oriel window where she sat Diana could see a projecting wing of the house itself
entries.subject: the deep oriel window where she sat Diana
entries.object: a projecting wing of the house itself

spans.text: From the deep oriel window where she sat Diana could see a projecting wing of the house itself, its mellowed red brick, its Jacobean windows and roof.

entries.task_id: that's|done|with
entries.description: that's done with
entries.subject: that's

spans.text: "Thank goodness!--that's done with," she thought--only to fall into a sudden remorse.

entries.task_id: how blessed to|have done|with the riviera
entries.description: how blessed to have done with the Riviera
entries.subject: how blessed to

spans.text: how blessed to have done with the Riviera, and its hybrid empty life, for good and all!--how blessed even, to have done with the Alps and Italy!--how blessed, above all, to have come _home!_--home into the heart of this English land--warm mother-heart, into which she, stranger and orphan, might creep and be at rest.

spans.text: They flowed on in a warm, mute rhetoric, till suddenly the Comic Spirit was there, and patriotic rapture began to see itself.
